title: 1. Foundations of Pacing
use_cases: Use when shaping reader engagement and emotional responses across a narrative
Implement when distinguishing between structural rhythm and overall story tempo
Configure when establishing seamless transitions between scenes and paragraphs
Use when adjusting the musicality of a text through sentence length and punctuation
content:
Definition of Pacing

- The speed at which a narrative unfolds.
- It shapes reader engagement and emotional response.

Rhythm vs. Pace

- Rhythm: the musicality of sentence structure, word choice, and punctuation.
- Pace: the overall tempo of the story or text.

Flow in Writing

- Seamless transition between ideas, scenes, and paragraphs.
- The sense that the reader moves naturally through the text.
